the-ticket.description: Branches into the storyline's four endings, listed in `endings` with the real ids the client serves in ending_list. The wiki describes the decision points as helping or betraying Mr. Kerman, paying Prapor, or seeking the Lightkeeper; each ending is gated by its own sub-quest.
the-ticket.notes: The reference capture's mutually exclusive sub-quest completions are emitted at chapter level as `mutuallyExclusiveQuestPairs`. Partial objective progress on both sides is allowed. Only pairs of resolved sub-quests within this chapter are included. Objective coverage is partial (see `referenceCoverage`): the client only returns a story sub-quest template once the player has reached it, so only the endings whose `objectiveCount` is above zero have objective-level evidence here. The armored case choice in Falling Skies affects available optional objectives (Lightkeeper access).

mapsZh.55f2d3fd4bdc2d5f408b4567 Description:
16 号化工厂的厂区和设施曾被非法租用给 Terra Group 公司。在“契约战争”期间，工厂一度成为 USEC 与 BEAR 双方争夺塔科夫市工业区控制权的激战战场。

随着之后的混乱加剧，工厂变成了幸存的市民、Scav 和各种武装人员的避风港，其中也包括残存的 USEC 和 BEAR 行动人员。
mapsZh.FAC_TRANSIT_14_COND: 需要TerraGroup实验室访问钥匙卡（1）
mapsZh.6733700029c367a3d40b02af Description: 该设施隶属于 TerraGroup 承包商之一 Knossos LLC 。公开资料显示，该公司主要承接游乐园以及主题公园的建造工作。不过从这里的设施布置来看，显然更接近一座要塞化的地堡，而不是什么新的主题乐园。
mapsZh.5704e3c2d2720bac5b8b4567 Description: Priozersk 自然保护区最近被西北联邦行政特区划为国家野生动物保护区。
mapsZh.5704e554d2720bac5b8b456e Description:
临近港口的海岸线占塔科夫郊区的很大一部分。

这个区域包含被废弃的村庄、现代化私人住宅、遍布海岸线的船运设施、加油站、气象观测站、通讯基站及其他商业设施。

海岸线的核心区域坐落着“蔚蓝海岸”疗养院。这座疗养院包含数栋建筑，整个综合体由附近的水电站独立供电。为了准备塔科夫港口的撤离行动，这里曾被TerraGroup及其相关部门用作临时安置场所收容其员工与承包商。
mapsZh.Smugglers_Trail_coop: 走私者之路（合作撤离点）
mapsZh.Shorl_V-Ex: 通往北方的路（载具撤离点）
mapsZh.SHO_TRANSIT_43_COND: 大概需要 Labrys 访问钥匙卡 (1)
mapsZh.5704e4dad2720bb55b8b4567 Description: 位于 Dalniy 海角的灯塔是通往塔科夫的路上极为重要的一处战略据点。在“契约战争”期间，灯塔曾是 USEC 们的主要登陆地点与行动基地。冲突结束之后，Scav 们又看中了这里。一切在基地的前主人们回归后起了变化：这些曾经的 PMC 们打算驻扎在塔科夫，建立属于他们的新秩序。
mapsZh.Scav_Underboat_Hideout: 浮动码头下方的藏身处
mapsZh.tr_lighthouse_icebreaker_cond: 需要移交「苏达克-图达克」工具套装
mapsZh.6a294a5b5eb5f9a1700417b7 Description: TerraGroup 实验室是一座深藏在塔科夫市中心地下的机密设施。尽管集团官方从未公开承认过这个研究中心的存在，但是仍有零散信息显示这里一直进行着化学、物理学、生物学及其它高科技领域的研发、测试和模拟工作。

16 号化工厂的厂区和设施曾被非法租用给 Terra Group 公司。这个工厂在“契约战争”期间成为了 USEC 和 BEAR 双方争夺塔科夫市工业区控制权的激战战场。

mapsZh.653e6760052c01c1c805532f Description: 塔科夫的经济中心，也是TerraGroup的总部驻地。这里就是一切开始的地方。
mapsZh.Sandbox_VExit: 警方封锁线（载具撤离点）
mapsZh.56f40101d2720b2a4d8b45d6 Description: 一个位于工厂附近的大型工业园区。此区域设有海关站、燃料储存设施、办公室、宿舍以及其它基础设施。
mapsZh.Custom_scav_pmc: 地下室锅炉房（合作撤离）
mapsZh.65b8d6f5cdde2479cb2a3125 Description: 塔科夫的经济中心，也是TerraGroup的总部驻地。这里就是一切开始的地方。自从冲突爆发以来，这里又一次成为了战事频发的热点地带。
mapsZh.68236e8153654e8c1200798a Description: 塔科夫的经济中心，也是TerraGroup的总部驻地。这里就是一切开始的地方。
mapsZh.5704e5fad2720bc05b8b4567 Description: 根据都市传说，联邦国家储备局的秘密基地有足以维持多年自给自足的物资，包括食物、药品和其他资源，能够满足在全面核战争中长期生存的一切需求。
mapsZh.5714dc692459777137212e12 Description: 塔科夫市中心拥有所有诸如银行，购物中心和旅馆等大都市需要的便利设施。
mapsZh.E7_car: Primorsky大道出租车载具撤离点
mapsZh.STR_TRANSIT_5_COND: 需要TerraGroup实验室访问钥匙卡（1）
mapsZh.69af492a4819ea4ba10a69c5 Description:
重重封锁下的塔科夫，在芬兰湾海域，尘封着一艘核动力破冰船 Boreas 号。这艘巨轮属于 Paradigm 航运公司，至于它为什么驶入塔科夫，以及船上搭载了什么货物，至今仍然是一个谜。 

看样子无论是 Paradigm 航运，还是背后的 TerraGroup 都竭尽全力避免在公开报道中提及这艘破冰船，它的航线与任务更是被列为机密。
mapsZh.5714dbc024597771384a510d Description: 南部立交桥是城市交通系统的重要枢纽。这里连接着塔科夫的港口区和市郊工业区，是名副其实的战略要地；区域中央则坐落着巨型 ULTRA 购物中心，曾被 EMERCOM 用作疏散行动的主基地。
mapsZh.65cc8f81a9aac3e77d0cfd3e Description: 自从塔科夫市内的冲突爆发以来，南部港口终点站就一直处于俄军正规军的控制之下。在城市被封锁后，这里瞬间变成了塔科夫地区的主要撤离点，各路难民以及零星 PMC 单位争相前往港口，试图逃离战区，港口守军也因此进一步加强了戒备。有未经证实的消息称， TerraGroup 的人员同样通过这个港口进行疏散。

Locate the escape path through the drainage system in [[The Lab]] ==Guide== ===Escape Ground Zero=== Finish the tutorial raid by extracting via the "Klimov Street" extraction which is located behind the "Skyside" business center. During the tutorial, numerous hints on controls and game mechanics are displayed, but none of them need to be followed in order to complete the raid.
  • File:Tutorial By xTycho.png|Map of the location
    • ===Talk to [[Therapist]]=== {|class="wikitable" ! colspan="5" |Related Quest Items |- !Icon !Item name !Amount !Requirement !'''[[Found in raid|Find in raid]]''' |- |[[File:roublesicon.png|link=Roubles]] |[[Roubles]] |250,000 |Handover item !No |} Visit [[Therapist]] in the menu through the trader screen and hand over 250,000 [[Roubles]] when the dialogue option appears. ====Rewards==== * Unlocks [[Streets of Tarkov]] in the location selection ===[[Ragman]] - [[Interchange]]=== Extract from [[Interchange]] with either the "Survived" or "Run-Through" extraction status, or visit the location 3 times. ====Rewards==== * Unlocks [[Skier]] as trader * Unlocks [[Customs]] in the location selection ===[[Skier]] - [[Customs]]=== {|class="wikitable" ! colspan="5" | Related Quest Items |- !Item name !Amount !Requirement !'''[[Found in raid|Find in raid]]''' !Notes |- |Any [[Loot#Building_materials|building materials]] or [[Loot#Tools|tools]] |5 |Handover item !Yes |Partial handover not possible |} Extract from [[Customs]] with either the "Survived" or "Run-Through" extraction status, or visit the location 3 times. ====Rewards==== * Unlocks [[Mechanic]] as trader * Unlocks [[Factory]] in the location selection ===[[Mechanic]] - [[Factory]]=== {|class="wikitable" ! colspan="4" | Related Quest Items |- !Item name !Amount !Requirement !'''[[Found in raid|Find in raid]]''' |- |Any [[weapons]] |2 |Handover item !Yes |} Extract from [[Factory]] with either the "Survived" or "Run-Through" extraction status, or visit the location 3 times. ====Rewards==== * Unlocks [[Prapor]] as trader * Unlocks [[Woods]] in the location selection ===[[Skier]] - [[Woods]]=== Kill any 3 targets on [[Woods]] and extract with either the "Survived" or "Run-Through" extraction status, or visit the location 3 times. The kills don't need to be performed in the same raid as the "survive" objective. ====Rewards==== * Unlocks [[Peacekeeper]] as trader * Unlocks [[Shoreline]] in the location selection ===Terminal=== To complete the next few objectives you have to go to the south-east corner of [[Shoreline]] and interact with the intercom at the watchtower in front of the Terminal. falling-skies.wikitext:
{{Infobox quest |image =Falling Skies Banner.png |icon =Falling Skies Icon.png |icon size = |location = |given by = |reward = |reputation = |quest number = |previous = |leads to =[[The Ticket]] |related = |related2 = |reqkappa = }} '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a [[Story chapters|story chapter]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''. ==Description== {{quote|Mechanic and I got to talking about that plane that went down somewhere in the nature reserve. Nobody really knows what happened to it. I should track it down and take a look — maybe I'll find something interesting.}} ==Requirements== Ask [[Mechanic]] about the downed plane while progressing through the story chapter [[Tour]]. ==Objectives== * Locate the fallen plane * Reach Loyalty Level 2 with [[Prapor]] * Ask the traders about the fallen plane * (''Optional'') Hand over 2,000 [[Dollars|USD]] to [[Therapist]] to learn details about the SUV * Retrieve the [[G-Wagon flash drive|flash drive]] from one of the G-Wagon SUVs * Hand over the [[G-Wagon flash drive|flash drive]] to [[Prapor]] * Wait for information from [[Prapor]] * Retrieve the [[Crashed plane's flight recorder|plane's flight recorder]] * Leave the [[Crashed plane's flight recorder|flight recorder]] in the specified spot * Visit [[Prapor]] * Hand over 3 found [[Found in raid|in raid]] [[Rechargeable battery|Rechargeable batteries]] * Hand over 5 found [[Found in raid|in raid]] [[Printed circuit board]]s * Hand over 2 found [[Found in raid|in raid]] [[Toolset]]s * Wait for information from [[Prapor]] * Hand over the [[Plane crew transcript|flight crew's transcript]] to [[Prapor]] * Hand over [[Elektronik's flash drive|Elektronik's secure flash drive]] to [[Prapor]] * Wait for information from [[Prapor]] * Retrieve the [[Armored case|armored case]] ** (''Optional'') Find any [[Note from Mr. Kerman|additional clues]] * Keep the [[Armored case|armored case]] for yourself '''or''' hand it over to [[Prapor]] ==Guide== ===Locate the fallen plane=== The fallen plane is located on the eastern side of [[Woods]].
  • File:Falling Skies Map.jpg|Location marked on map File:Woods Showcase 12.png|The wanted plane
    • ===Speak to [[Prapor]]=== Visit [[Prapor]] in the menu through the trader screen and ask him about the fallen plane. ===Reach Loyalty Level 2 with [[Prapor]]=== To get further information about the plane, you have to reach loyalty level 2 with [[Prapor]] and then ask him again about the fallen plane. ===Ask the traders about the fallen plane=== Visit [[Prapor]], [[Therapist]], [[Skier]], [[Mechanic]] and [[Jaeger]] in the menu through the trader screen and ask them about the fallen plane. ===(''Optional'') Hand over 2,000 [[Dollars|USD]] to [[Therapist]] to learn details about the SUV=== {|class="wikitable" ! colspan="5" |Related Quest Items |- !Icon !Item name !Amount !Requirement !'''[[Found in raid|Find in raid]]''' |- ![[File:dollarsicon.png|link=Dollars]] |[[Dollars]] |2,000 |Handover item !No |} Visit [[Therapist]] in the menu through the trader screen and ask her about information on the fallen plane. Upon handing over 2,000 [[Dollars|USD]], she reveals the position of the wanted SUV. ===Retrieve the flash drive from one of the G-Wagon SUVs=== {|class="wikitable" ! colspan="5" |Related Quest Items |- !Icon !Item name !Amount !Requirement !'''[[Found in raid|Find in raid]]''' |- ![[File:G-Wagon flash drive icon.png|link=G-Wagon flash drive]] |[[G-Wagon flash drive]] |1 |Handover item !Yes |} The [[G-Wagon flash drive]] can be found on the driver side running board of the G-Wagon SUV next to the "Tunnel" extraction on [[Shoreline]].
  • File:FallingSkiesGWagonUSBMap.png|Location marked on map File:FallingSkiesGWagonUSBSpawn.png|The wanted SUV with the flash drive on the running board
    • Hand the [[G-Wagon flash drive]] over to [[Prapor]] through the trader screen. ===Wait for the information from [[Prapor]]=== Wait 1 hour then visit [[Prapor]] in the menu through the trader screen and ask him about the fallen plane. ===Retrieve the plane's flight recorder=== {|class="wikitable" ! colspan="5" |Related Quest Items |- !Icon !Item name !Amount !Requirement !'''[[Found in raid|Find in raid]]''' |- ![[File:Crashed plane's flight recorder icon.png|link=Crashed plane's flight recorder]] |[[Crashed plane's flight recorder]] |1 |Required !Yes |} The fallen plane is located on the eastern side of [[Woods]], where the [[Crashed plane's flight recorder]] can be found on the right side of the plane in the broken section near the back.
  • File:Falling Skies Map.jpg|Plane location marked on map File:Woods Showcase 12.png|The wanted plane File:FallingSkiesFlightRecorderSpawn.png|The broken section with the recorder File:FallingSkiesFlightRecorderSpawnCloseUp.png|The recorder
    • ====Leave the flight recorder in the specified spot==== {|class="wikitable" ! colspan="6" |Related Quest Items |- !Icon !Item name !Amount !Requirement !'''[[Found in raid|Find in raid]]''' !Notes |- ![[File:Crashed plane's flight recorder icon.png|link=Crashed plane's flight recorder]] |[[Crashed plane's flight recorder]] |1 |Required !N/A |Stashed item |} The [[Crashed plane's flight recorder]] has to be stashed at the destroyed room in the house on the [[Shoreline]] island.
  • File:FallingSkiesFlightRecorderStashMap.png|House location marked on map File:FallingSkiesFlightRecorderStashLocation.png|Stashing location
    • ===Visit [[Prapor]]=== {|class="wikitable" ! colspan="6" |Related Quest Items |- !Icon !Item name !Amount !Requirement !'''[[Found in raid|Find in raid]]''' !Notes |- ![[File:Toolsicon.png|link=Toolset]] |[[Toolset]] |2 |Handover item !Yes |Can be crafted in the [[Hideout]] (Workbench lv. 1). |- ![[File:recicon.png|link=Rechargeable battery]] |[[Rechargeable battery]] |3 |Handover item !Yes |Can be crafted in the [[Hideout]] (Workbench lv. 2). |- ![[File:Circuit Icon.png|link=Printed circuit board]] |[[Printed circuit board]] |5 |Handover item !Yes |Can be crafted in the [[Hideout]] (Workbench lv. 1). |} [[Prapor]] asks for these items to continue. ===Wait for the information from [[Prapor]]=== Wait 3-5 hours then visit [[Prapor]] in the menu through the trader screen and ask him about the fallen plane. ===Hand over the flight crew's transcript and Elektronik's secure flash drive to [[Prapor]]=== {|class="wikitable" ! colspan="5" |Related Quest Items |- !Icon !Item name !Amount !Requirement !'''[[Found in raid|Find in raid]]''' |- ![[File:Plane crew transcript icon.png|link=Plane crew transcript]] |[[Plane crew transcript]] |1 |Handover item !Yes |- ![[File:Elektronik's flash drive icon.png|link=Elektronik's flash drive]] |[[Elektronik's flash drive]] |1 |Handover item !Yes |} Both items can be found in the chairman's house on [[Shoreline]].
  • File:FallingSkiesElektroniksUSBMap.png|House location marked on map File:Chairman house.png|The wanted house File:FallingSkiesElektroniksTranscript.png|The transcript under mattress at the overturned bed File:FallingSkiesElektroniksFlashDrive.png|The flash drive on top of the shelf next to the bed
    • ====Rewards==== You will receive the reward once you hand over both items. * 300,000 Roubles ** 315,000 Roubles with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 1 ** 345,000 Roubles with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 2 ===Wait for the information from Prapor=== Wait 1-3 hours then visit [[Prapor]] in the menu through the trader screen and ask him about the fallen plane. [[Prapor]] asks if you read the transcript and if you answer with yes, you'll get a reward, if you answer with no you won't. ====Rewards==== * 300,000 Roubles ** 315,000 Roubles with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 1 ** 345,000 Roubles with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 2 ===Retrieve the armored case/Find any additional clues=== {|class="wikitable" ! colspan="5" |Related Quest Items |- !Icon !Item name !Amount !Requirement !'''[[Found in raid|Find in raid]]''' |- ![[File:Armored case icon.png|link=Armored case]] |[[Armored case]] |1 |Handover item !Yes |- ![[File:Note from Mr. Kerman icon.png|link=Note from Mr. Kerman]] |[[Note from Mr. Kerman]] |1 |Optional !Yes |} The [[Armored case]] can be found behind the cockpit of the fallen plane, and the optional [[Note from Mr. Kerman]] is located on the pilot seat.
  • File:FallingSkiesArmoredCaseSpawn.png|The [[Armored case]] File:FallingSkiesKermanNoteSpawn.png|The [[Note from Mr. Kerman]]
    • ===Keep the armored case for yourself or hand it over to [[Prapor]]=== '''This is an important point of no return choice! The rewards differ depending on the decision.''' ====Decision: Keep the armored case==== =====Rewards===== * +80,000 [[EXP]] * [[Prapor]] Rep '''-0.7''' * 1× [[Armored case]] * Unlocks achievement [[Achievements#Achievements|Just Business]] ====Decision: Hand over the armored case directly to [[Prapor]]==== =====Rewards===== * +80,000 [[EXP]] * 1,500,000 [[Roubles]] * Unlocks achievement [[Achievements#Achievements|Man of His Word]] ====Decision: Pretend you didn't find the armored case, but still hand it over to [[Prapor]]==== =====Rewards===== * +80,000 [[EXP]] * 1,000,000 [[Roubles]] * Unlocks achievement [[Achievements#Achievements|Man of His Word]] {{Navbox story chapters}} [[Category:Story chapters]] [[fr:Tombé du ciel]] [[ru:Небеса в огне]]

    • ===Retrieve more information about the ambush from Moreman's phone=== {|class="wikitable" ! colspan="6" |Related Quest Items |- !Icon !Item name !Amount !Requirement !'''[[Found in raid|Find in raid]]''' !Notes |- ![[File:Moreman's audio tape 1 icon.png|link=Moreman's audio tape 1]] |[[Moreman's audio tape 1|Moreman's audio tape #1]] |1 |Required !N/A |Has to be crafted in the [[Hideout]] (Workbench lv. 1). |- ![[File:Moreman's audio tape 2 icon.png|link=Moreman's audio tape 2]] |[[Moreman's audio tape 2|Moreman's audio tape #2]] |1 |Required !N/A |Has to be crafted in the [[Hideout]] (Workbench lv. 1). |} Craft [[Moreman's audio tape 1|Moreman's audio tape #1]] and [[Moreman's audio tape 2|Moreman's audio tape #2]] at the Workbench level 1 in the [[Hideout]] and listen to them. Electricity is required during the entire process, otherwise it will be interrupted. ===Obtain Intelligence Center level 3=== Upgrade the Intelligence Center to level 3 in the [[Hideout]]. ===Contact the Bogatyr squad=== Contact Voevoda through the radio system at the Intelligence Center in the [[Hideout]]. First enter the frequency "35.70", as hinted at from the [[First piece of code note]] and [[Second piece of code note]]. Next enter the code "27.893.2000" as hinted at from [[Strelets' note]].
  • File:Batya Contact Voevoda via Intel Center 3 1.png|The radio system File:Batya Contact Voevoda via Intel Center 3 2.png|Enter frequency "35.70" File:Batya Contact Voevoda via Intel Center 3 3.png|Enter code "27.893.2000"
    • ===Gain access to [[Lightkeeper]]=== Lightkeeper can be found on the [[Lighthouse]] location. He is located in a locked area on the 3rd floor of the lighthouse building at the peninsula territory.
  • File:LightkeeperMap.png|Lighthouse location marked on map File:Lightkeeper Area Door.png|Locked area door
    • The bridge that leads to the lighthouse is guarded by [[Zryachiy]] and full of [[Map of Tarkov#Claymores|Claymores]]. To safely pass the bridge and speak to Lightkeeper, an encoded [[Digital secure DSP radio transmitter]] is required. It deactivates the claymores and has Zryachiy not shoot you. The questline to obtain one starts with the quest [[To the Light - Trust but Verify]]. Harming Zryachiy, one of his followers, or a Lightkeeper acquainted PMC in the lighthouse premises will decode your [[Digital secure DSP radio transmitter]] if you have it equipped ('''Attention:''' Unequipping it does not prevent this in '''local''' [[Game_modes#PvE_and_PvE_Co-op_game_mode|PvE game mode]] raids). PMC's that are acquainted with Lightkeeper can kill unacquainted intruders without penalty. ===Bring all the Bogatyr squad's items to [[Lightkeeper]]=== {|class="wikitable" ! colspan="5" |Related Quest Items |- !Icon !Item name !Amount !Requirement !'''[[Found in raid|Find in raid]]''' |- ![[File:Taran's postcard icon.png|link=Taran's postcard]] |[[Taran's postcard]] |1 |Handover item !Yes |- ![[File:Voevoda's audio recorder (quest item) icon.png|link=Voevoda's audio recorder (quest item)]] |[[Voevoda's audio recorder (quest item)|Voevoda's audio recorder]] |1 |Handover item !Yes |- ![[File:Strelets' amulet icon.png|link=Strelets' amulet]] |[[Strelets' amulet]] |1 |Handover item !Yes |- ![[File:Moreman's dogtag icon.png|link=Moreman's dogtag]] |[[Moreman's dogtag]] |1 |Handover item !Yes |- ![[File:Bogatyrs patch icon.png|link=Bogatyrs patch]] |[[Bogatyrs patch]] |1 |Handover item !Yes |} Transfer [[Taran's postcard]], [[Voevoda's audio recorder (quest item)|Voevoda's audio recorder]], [[Strelets' amulet]], [[Moreman's dogtag]] and the [[Bogatyrs patch]] to the in-raid quest inventory and hand them over to [[Lightkeeper]]. ===Wait for Voevoda to reach out=== Wait 6-12 hours for Voevoda to reach out, then contact him through the radio system at the Intelligence Center [[Hideout]]. Enter frequency "35.70" and the code "27.893.2000" again.
  • File:Batya Contact Voevoda via Intel Center 3 1.png|The radio system File:Batya Contact Voevoda via Intel Center 3 2.png|Enter frequency "35.70" File:Batya Contact Voevoda via Intel Center 3 3.png|Enter code "27.893.2000"
    • ===Complete Voevoda's tasks=== * Reach the [[Light Machine Guns|Light Machine Guns skill]] level 5 * Reach the [[Assault Rifles|Assault Rifles skill]] level 10 * Reach the [[Stress Resistance|Stress Resistance skill]] level 10 * Reach the [[Strength|Strength skill]] level 15 * Eliminate any 15 targets without dying * Eliminate 4 PMC operatives without dying ===Contact Voevoda=== Contact Voevoda through the radio system at the Intelligence Center in the [[Hideout]]. Enter frequency "35.70" and the code "27.893.2000" again.
  • File:Batya Contact Voevoda via Intel Center 3 1.png|The radio system File:Batya Contact Voevoda via Intel Center 3 2.png|Enter frequency "35.70" File:Batya Contact Voevoda via Intel Center 3 3.png|Enter code "27.893.2000"
    • ===Locate the traces of the traitors=== {|class="wikitable" ! colspan="5" |Related Quest Items |- !Icon !Item name !Amount !Requirement !'''[[Found in raid|Find in raid]]''' |- ![[File:Note mentioning Prapor icon.png|link=Note mentioning Prapor]] |[[Note mentioning Prapor]] |1 |Required !Yes |} The [[Note mentioning Prapor]] to pick up and read to fulfill this objective can be found at the BEAR camp on [[Lighthouse]].
  • File:Bogatyrs patch Lighthouse map.png|BEAR camp location marked on map File:Bogatyrs patch Lighthouse BEAR camp.png|The camp File:Note mentioning prapor.png|Note on the table with the radio system
    • ===Interrogate [[Prapor]]=== Visit [[Prapor]] in the menu through the trader screen. ===Figure out how the cultists are connected to the General=== {|class="wikitable" ! colspan="5" |Related Quest Items |- !Icon !Item name !Amount !Requirement !'''[[Found in raid|Find in raid]]''' |- ![[File:Voevoda's photo with a cultist mark icon.png|link=Voevoda's photo with a cultist mark]] |[[Voevoda's photo with a cultist mark]] |1 |Required !Yes |- ![[File:Note mentioning General icon.png|link=Note mentioning General]] |[[Note mentioning General]] |1 |Required !Yes |- ![[File:Marked-key-Icon.png|link=Dorm room 314 marked key]] |[[Dorm room 314 marked key]] |1 |Required'''*''' !N/A |} '''*'''Not all spawn locations for the quest item require this key. It is not entirely needed to complete the objective. To fulfill this objective, you have to pick up and read 2 notes from [[Shoreline]] and either [[Woods]] or [[Customs]]. ====Voevoda's photo with a cultist mark - Shoreline==== In the house on the island.
  • File:WetJob2IslandMap.png|Island location marked on map File:Voevoda's photo with a cultist mark Spawn.png|The note on the floor
    • ====Note mentioning General==== =====Woods===== At the marked circle in the woods west of the sawmill near the checkpoint.
  • File:WoodsSouthernMarkedCircleMap.png|Location marked on map File:Cultists ritual place.png|The marked circle File:Note mentioning General Woods Spawn.png|The note next to the candles
    • =====Customs===== In the marked room on the third floor of the three-story dorms building. A [[Dorm room 314 marked key]] is required to enter it.
  • File:TheCultPart2DormsMap.png|Room location marked on map File:Marked Room Door.png|Door to the room File:Dorm 314 general note.png|The note on the wall
    • ===Talk to [[Lightkeeper]]=== Visit [[Lightkeeper]] on [[Lighthouse]]. ===Wait for [[Lightkeeper]] to prepare the documents on The Unheard=== {|class="wikitable" ! colspan="5" |Related Quest Items |- !Icon !Item name !Amount !Requirement !'''[[Found in raid|Find in raid]]''' |- ![[File:Agent network deployment report icon.png|link=Agent network deployment report]] |[[Agent network deployment report]] |1 |Required !Yes |} In a new raid, return to [[Lightkeeper]]'s area on [[Lighthouse]] and pick up and read the [[Agent network deployment report]]. The objective will be completed after 6 hours.

A [[TerraGroup storage room keycard]] is required to enter it. Both have multiple spawns throughout the room.

The optional [[Fragment of an unknown document]] can be found on the left nightstand.

    • The optional [[Guard post note]] to locate the room can be found on the first floor of the health resort west wing, on the desk next to the security room at the southern entrance.

    • ===Decrypt the flash drive from A.P.'s room=== {|class="wikitable" ! colspan="6" |Related Quest Items |- !Icon !Item name !Amount !Requirement !'''[[Found in raid|Find in raid]]''' !Notes |- ![[File:Decrypted Sliderkey flash drive marked with A.P. icon.png|link=Decrypted Sliderkey flash drive marked with A.P.]] |[[Decrypted Sliderkey flash drive marked with A.P.]] |1 |Required !N/A |Has to be crafted in the [[Hideout]] (Intelligence center lv. 1). |} Craft the [[Decrypted Sliderkey flash drive marked with A.P.]] at the Intelligence Center level 1 in the [[Hideout]]. Electricity is required during the entire process, otherwise it will be interrupted. ===Ask [[Mechanic]] for help=== Visit [[Mechanic]] in the menu through the trader screen and ask him about the flash drive. He will say that he cannot help, but that Elektronik can if you hand over 5,000,000 [[Roubles]]. ===Hand over 5,000,000 [[Roubles]] and the A.P. flash drive to [[Mechanic]]=== {|class="wikitable" ! colspan="5" |Related Quest Items |- !Icon !Item name !Amount !Requirement !'''[[Found in raid|Find in raid]]''' |- ![[File:roublesicon.png|link=Roubles]] |[[Roubles]] |5,000,000 |Handover item !No |- ![[File:Decrypted Sliderkey flash drive marked with A.P. icon.png|link=Decrypted Sliderkey flash drive marked with A.P.]] |[[Decrypted Sliderkey flash drive marked with A.P.]] |1 |Handover item !N/A |} Hand 5,000,000 [[Roubles]] and the [[Decrypted Sliderkey flash drive marked with A.P.]] over to [[Mechanic]] through the trader screen. ===Wait for the news from Elektronik=== If you haven't had contact with Mr. Kerman before: Wait 6-12 hours then visit [[Mechanic]] in the menu through the trader screen. If you had contact with Mr. Kerman before: Wait 1 and half a hour for Mr. Kerman to contact you and speak to him. ===Integrate the files from A.P.'s flash drive into a keycard and access the hidden room in his apartment=== {|class="wikitable" ! colspan="6" |Related Quest Items |- !Icon !Item name !Amount !Requirement !'''[[Found in raid|Find in raid]]''' !Notes |- ![[File:TerraGroup corporate apartment key icon.png|link=TerraGroup corporate apartment key]] |[[TerraGroup corporate apartment key]] |1 |Required !N/A |Unlocks A.P.'s apartment in the Cardinal apartment complex on [[Streets of Tarkov]]. |- ![[File:Reprogrammed keycard for A.P.'s apartment lock (Green) icon.png|link=Reprogrammed keycard for A.P.'s apartment lock (Green)]] |[[Reprogrammed keycard for A.P.'s apartment lock (Green)]] |1 |Required !N/A |Unlocks the hidden room in A.P.'s apartment. Has to be crafted in the [[Hideout]] (Intelligence center lv. 1). |} You first have to craft the [[Reprogrammed keycard for A.P.'s apartment lock (Green)]] at the Intelligence Center level 1 in the [[Hideout]]. The [[Reprogrammed keycard for A.P.'s apartment lock (Blue)|blue]] and [[Reprogrammed keycard for A.P.'s apartment lock (Red)|red]] ones are false leads. A.P.'s apartment is apartment 1 on the second floor of the Cardinal apartment complex on [[Streets of Tarkov]]. A [[TerraGroup corporate apartment key]] is required to enter it. Once inside the apartment, you have to go down the hallway to find the hidden room opened with the crafted keycard. In the room are 4 notes to pick up and read.

    • ==Objectives== * Talk to [[Mechanic]] about the EMP blast ** (''Optional'') Gain access to [[Mechanic]] * Locate and obtain the [[Unknown device fragment|device fragment]] * Hand over the [[Unknown device fragment|device fragment]] to [[Mechanic]] * Plant the [[Local network hacking device|hacking device]] in the server room in [[the Lab]] * Talk to [[Mechanic]] * Keep the [[Unknown device fragment|fragment of Item 1156]] for yourself or hand it over to [[Mechanic]] * Find a [[Note mentioning Item 1156|lead on Item 1156]] * [[Rus Post audio tape 11.05 / 003|Investigate]] the Rus Post office * Locate the [[Rus Post car key|Rus Post Car]] * Obtain the [[Item 1156 specification|blueprint for Item 1156]] ==Guide== ===Talk to [[Mechanic]] about the EMP blast=== Visit [[Mechanic]] in the menu through the trader screen and ask him about the EMP blast. ===Locate and obtain the device fragment=== {|class="wikitable" ! colspan="5" |Related Quest Items |- !Icon !Item name !Amount !Requirement !'''[[Found in raid|Find in raid]]''' |- ![[File:Car dealership closed section key icon.png|link=Car dealership closed section key]] |[[Car dealership closed section key]] |1 |Required'''*''' !N/A |- ![[File:Mysterious marked key icon.png|link=Mysterious room marked key]] |[[Mysterious room marked key]] |1 |Required'''*''' !N/A |- ![[File:Unknown device fragment icon.png|link=Unknown device fragment]] |[[Unknown device fragment]] |1 |Handover item !Yes |} '''*'''Only one of the keys is required to complete the objective. The [[Unknown device fragment]] can either be obtained in the closed section on the second floor of the LexOs car dealership, or in the marked room located inside the Chekannaya 13 apartment building on [[Streets of Tarkov]]. ====LexOs car dealership==== A [[Car dealership closed section key]] is required to enter the closed section. Be aware that the premises of the LexOs car dealership are riddled with [[Claymores]].
  • File:CarDealerMap.png|Car dealership marked on map File:LexOsClaymoreOverview.png|LexOs complex overview File:CarDealer.png|The car dealership File:CarDealerClosedSectionDoor.png|Grate door to the closed section File:Blue Fire Device Fragment inside LexOS Sect..png|The device in a food container
    • ====Chekannaya 13 apartment building marked room==== A [[Mysterious room marked key]] is required to enter the room.
  • File:Mysterious marked key onmap.png|Room location marked on map File:Mysterious key building entrance.png|Entrance to the building through a window from the courtyard File:Mysterious key path1.png|Once inside, get in the corridor and move to the second room on the left File:Mysterious key path2.png|In the bedroom, go through the hole in the wall File:Mysterious key path3.png|After going through the hole, get downstairs and open the door to the left File:Mysterious key room door.png|You get in front of the door to unlock File:Chek13 MRK img.png|The device in the flower pot

[[Mechanic]] provides one via in-game mail and has a barter for more available.
  • File:Labs Server Room Plant Location.png|Stashing location marked on map File:Labs Server Room Plant Location 2.png|Stashing location next to the office chairs
    • ===Talk to [[Mechanic]]=== Visit [[Mechanic]] in the menu through the trader screen. ===Keep the fragment of Item 1156 for yourself or hand it over to [[Mechanic]]=== ====Decision: Keep the fragment==== =====Rewards===== * Unlocks achievement [[Achievements#Achievements|Better Served]] ====Decision: Hand over the fragment to [[Mechanic]]==== =====Rewards===== * 1,500,000 [[Roubles]] ===Find a lead on Item 1156=== {|class="wikitable" ! colspan="5" |Related Quest Items |- !Icon !Item name !Amount !Requirement !'''[[Found in raid|Find in raid]]''' |- ![[File:TerraGroup science office key icon.png|link=TerraGroup science office key]] |[[TerraGroup science office key]] |1 |Required'''*''' !N/A |- ![[File:Note mentioning Item 1156 icon.png|link=Note mentioning Item 1156]] |[[Note mentioning Item 1156|Note mentioning Item #1156]] |1 |Required !Yes |} '''*'''Not all spawn locations for the item require this key. It is not entirely needed. The [[Note mentioning Item 1156|Note mentioning Item #1156]] to pick up and read can be obtained on [[Ground Zero|Ground Zero (Level 21+)]], [[Lighthouse]] or in [[The Lab]]. ====Ground Zero (Level 21+)==== In office no. 4 on the second floor of the TerraGroup main building. A [[TerraGroup science office key]] is required to enter.
  • File:Saving the Mole Map.png|TerraGroup building location marked on map File:Ground Zero TerraGroup Building.png|The TerraGroup building File:Scientist's Office.png|Door to the office File:Blue Fire Note on the Ground Zero.png|The note on the desk in the back right
    • ====Lighthouse==== In the northern blue chalet, on the first floor in a bookshelf near the central stairs.
  • File:BlueChaletMapKTT.png|Chalet location marked on map File:BlueFire2.png|The bookshelf with the note
    • ====The Lab==== On the second floor, in office O22 on a desk.
  • File:Blue Fire Office in the laboratory map.png|Office location marked on map File:Blue Fire Note in the Lab 01.png|Desk with the note File:Blue Fire Note in the Lab 02.png|Note on the desk
    • ===Investigate the Rus Post office=== {|class="wikitable" ! colspan="5" |Related Quest Items |- !Icon !Item name !Amount !Requirement !'''[[Found in raid|Find in raid]]''' |- ![[File:Audio recorder icon.png|link=Audio recorder]] |[[Audio recorder]] |1 |Required !N/A |- ![[File:Rus Post audio tape 11.05 - 001 icon.png|link=Rus Post audio tape 11.05 / 001]] |[[Rus Post audio tape 11.05 / 001]] |1 |Required !Yes |- ![[File:Rus Post audio tape 11.05 - 002 icon.png|link=Rus Post audio tape 11.05 / 002]] |[[Rus Post audio tape 11.05 / 002]] |1 |Required !Yes |- ![[File:Rus Post audio tape 11.05 - 003 icon.png|link=Rus Post audio tape 11.05 / 003]] |[[Rus Post audio tape 11.05 / 003]] |1 |Required !Yes |} To fulfill this objective, you have to pick up and listen to 3 audio tapes located in the post office on [[Streets of Tarkov]].
  • File:PostOfficeMap.png|Post office marked on map File:PostOffice.png|The post office File:Rus Post audio tape 1 spawn.png|Tape #1 on the desk with the screen behind the counter File:Rus Post audio tape 2 spawn.png|Tape #2 on top of the coffee vending machine next to the storage room File:Rus Post audio tape 3 spawn.png|Tape #3 on the desk in the back office accessed through the hallway behind the counter
    • ===Locate the Rus Post Car/Obtain the blueprint for Item 1156=== {|class="wikitable" ! colspan="5" |Related Quest Items |- !Icon !Item name !Amount !Requirement !'''[[Found in raid|Find in raid]]''' |- ![[File:Rus Post car key icon.png|link=Rus Post car key]] |[[Rus Post car key]] |1 |Required !N/A |- ![[File:Item 1156 specification icon.png|link=Item 1156 specification]] |[[Item 1156 specification|Item #1156 specification]] |1 |Required !Yes |} The car is located in front of the post office. The [[Item 1156 specification|Item #1156 specification]] to pick up and read can be found in the back of the car. To unlock it, a [[Rus Post car key]] is required. A single key is guaranteed to spawn every raid on the ground next to the back right wheel of the car.
  • File:Rus Post car key Location.png|The post car File:RusPostCarKeySpawn.png|The key next to the wheel File:The Ticket Item 1156 Specification Spawn.png|The blueprint
    • ====Rewards==== * +112,000 [[EXP]] * Unlocks achievement [[Achievements#Achievements|Inferno]] {{Navbox story chapters}} [[Category:Story chapters]] [[ru:Синий Огонь]]

they-are-already-here.wikitext:
{{Infobox quest |image =They Are Already Here Banner.png |icon =They Are Already Here Icon.png |icon size = |location = |given by = |reward = |reputation = |quest number = |previous = |leads to = |related = |related2 = |reqkappa = }} '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a [[Story chapters|story chapter]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''. ==Requirements== Pick up and read [[Note about the Eye of the World]] from one of the following locations: * In the "[[Dorm room 314 marked key|marked room]]" at the three-story dorms on [[Customs]]
  • File:They Are Already Here Customs Activation Location.png|Note on a stack of books
    • * In the "marked rooms" [[RB-BK marked key|RB-BK]], [[RB-VO marked key|RB-VO]] and [[RB-PKPM marked key|RB-PKPM]] on [[Reserve]]
  • File:They Are Already Here Reserve Activation Location 1.png|In RB-BK on the table with the pig carcass File:They Are Already Here Reserve Activation Location 2.png|In RB-VO on the table with the pig carcass File:They Are Already Here Reserve Activation Location 3.png|In RB-PKPM on the desk
    • * At the marked circle in the dilapidated village in the north of [[Woods]]
  • File:They Are Already Here Woods Activation Location Map.png|Circle location marked on map File:They Are Already Here Woods Activation Location.png|Note next to the burning candles
    • * In the house on the island on [[Shoreline]]
  • File:WetJob2IslandMap.png|Island location marked on map File:EOTW Shoreline location.png|Note on the floor in the house
    • ==Objectives== * [[Note about the Eye of the World|Learn more]] about the hooded men/[[Note about the Eye of the World|Learn more]] about the people leaving strange symbols in Tarkov * Locate a place connected to the Eye of the World * [[Cult victim audio tape 2|Learn more]] about the cultist's victim from the torture room * Locate the [[Cult victim's apartment key|cult victim's apartment]] ** (''Optional'') Obtain the [[Cult victim's apartment key|key]] to the apartment * Investigate the victim's apartment * Obtain the [[Cult victim audio tape 1|victim's first audio tape]] * Obtain and read the [[Book of the Arrival|book]] that the cultists planted with Igor * Ask [[Mechanic]] about the Eye of the World ** (''Optional'') Gain access to [[Mechanic]] * Locate and neutralize a [[Cultist priest]] * Obtain more [[Cultist priest's note|information]] about the Eye of the World * Locate the place marked with the Eye of the World on [[Lighthouse]] * Investigate the ransacked cultist room in the chalet ** (''Optional'') Locate the [[Victim's note|victim's belongings]] * Locate and obtain the [[Station 14-4 KORD Arshavin K. pass (Damaged)|key]] mentioned in the [[victim's note]] * Locate the place marked with the Eye of the World on [[Woods]] * [[Newspaper clipping from the cultists' house|Investigate]] the cultists' house marked with the Eye of the World * Locate the place marked with the Eye of the World on [[Shoreline]] * [[Programmer's note|Investigate]] the area around the Sordi communications tower * [[Toolset|Repair]] the Sordi tower * Restore [[Station 14-4 KORD Arshavin K. pass (Damaged)|Arshavin's keycard]] * Gain [[Station 14-4 KORD Arshavin K. pass (Restored)|access]] to NGO Cobalt's secret facility * Restore power at the station * Turn on the cooling system in the server room * Install a [[Secure Flash drive|flash drive]] to download the data * [[Mysterious audio tape|Investigate]] ARRS Station 14-4 KORD thoroughly * Survive and extract from [[Interchange]] * [[ARRS station mechanic's notes|Find a way]] to disconnect the station from external agents * Restore the ARRS station to backup settings ** (''Optional'') Check that the station power is turned on * Collect the [[Flash drive for ARRS station|flash drive]] from the ARRS station * Survive and extract from [[Interchange]] * Hand over the [[Flash drive for ARRS station|flash drive with data]] to [[Mechanic]] * Read the [[ARRS system specifications|ARRS station specifications]] ==Guide== ===Learn more about the hooded men/Learn more about the people leaving strange symbols in Tarkov=== See [[They Are Already Here#Requirements|requirements]]. ===Locate a place connected to the Eye of the World/Learn more about the cultist's victim from the torture room=== {|class="wikitable" ! colspan="5" |Related Quest Items |- !Icon !Item name !Amount !Requirement !'''[[Found in raid|Find in raid]]''' |- ![[File:Cult victim audio tape 2 icon.png|link=Cult victim audio tape 2]] |[[Cult victim audio tape 2|Cult victim audio tape #2]] |1 |Required !Yes |} To fulfill these objectives, you have to locate the Cultist's torture house on [[Lighthouse]] and pick up and listen to the audio tape found there.
  • File:Cult victims apartment key Spawn Map.png|House location marked on map File:Cult victims apartment key Spawn House.png|The wanted house File:Cult victim audio tape 2 spawn.png|The tape on the chair
    • The [[Cult victim's apartment key]] required for the next objective can also be obtained in the house.
  • File:Cult victims apartment key Spawn 4.png|Spawn 1 on the fallen over shelf File:Cult victims apartment key Spawn 1.png|Spawn 2 on the chair File:Cult victims apartment key Spawn 2.png|Spawn 3 on the wooden table File:Cult victims apartment key Spawn 3.png|Spawn 4 on the metal table
    • ===Locate the cult victim's apartment=== {|class="wikitable" ! colspan="5" |Related Quest Items |- !Icon !Item name !Amount !Requirement !'''[[Found in raid|Find in raid]]''' |- ![[File:Cult victim's apartment key icon.png|link=Cult victim's apartment key]] |[[Cult victim's apartment key]] |1 |Required !N/A |} The wanted apartment is located on the third floor of the old apartment building behind the Klimov shopping mall on [[Streets of Tarkov]]. A [[Cult victim's apartment key]] is required to enter it.
  • File:CultVictimsApartmentKeyMap.png|Building location marked on map File:CultVictimsApartmentKeyBuilding.png|The old apartment building File:CultVictimsApartmentKeyDoor.png|Door to apartment 5
    • ===Investigate the victim's apartment/Obtain the victim's first audio tape and the book the Cultists planted=== {|class="wikitable" ! colspan="5" |Related Quest Items |- !Icon !Item name !Amount !Requirement !'''[[Found in raid|Find in raid]]''' |- ![[File:Note on preparations for the Arrival icon.png|link=Note on preparations for the Arrival]] |[[Note on preparations for the Arrival]] |1 |Required !Yes |- ![[File:Cult victim audio tape 1 icon.png|link=Cult victim audio tape 1]] |[[Cult victim audio tape 1|Cult victim audio tape #1]] |1 |Required !Yes |- ![[File:Book of the Arrival icon.png|link=Book of the Arrival]] |[[Book of the Arrival]] |1 |Required !Yes |} To fulfill these objectives, you have to pick up and read 2 notes as well as pick up and listen to an audio tape from the office inside the apartment. The door has to be breached.
  • File:Cult Victim Apartment Office.png|Door to the office File:Book on the Arrival.png|The book on the bookshelf File:Note on preparations for the Arrival.png|The note on the desk File:Cult Victim Tape 1.png|The tape on the desk
    • ===Ask [[Mechanic]] about the Eye of the World=== Visit [[Mechanic]] in the menu through the trader screen and ask him about the Eye of the World. ===Locate and neutralize a Cultist priest=== Kill a [[Cultist priest]] on any location. ===Obtain more information about the Eye of the World=== {|class="wikitable" ! colspan="5" |Related Quest Items |- !Icon !Item name !Amount !Requirement !'''[[Found in raid|Find in raid]]''' |- ![[File:Marked-key-Icon.png|link=Dorm room 314 marked key]] |[[Dorm room 314 marked key]] |1 |Required'''*''' !N/A |- ![[File:Abandoned factory marked key icon.png|link=Abandoned factory marked key]] |[[Abandoned factory marked key]] |1 |Required'''*''' !N/A |- ![[File:RB-BK Icon.png|link=RB-BK marked key]] |[[RB-BK marked key]] |1 |Required'''*''' !N/A |- ![[File:RB-PKPM key icon.png|link=RB-PKPM marked key]] |[[RB-PKPM marked key]] |1 |Required'''*''' !N/A |- ![[File:RB-VO key icon.png|link=RB-VO marked key]] |[[RB-VO marked key]] |1 |Required'''*''' !N/A |- ![[File:Cultist priest's note icon.png|link=Cultist priest's note]] |[[Cultist priest's note]] |1 |Required !Yes |} '''*'''Only one of the keys is required to complete the objective. To fulfill this objective, you have to pick up and read the [[Cultist priest's note]] from one of the marked rooms on [[Customs]], [[Streets of Tarkov]] or [[Reserve]]. '''Note:''' The item doesn't spawn before the previous objective is completed. ====Customs==== Marked room on the third floor of the three-story dorms building. A [[Dorm room 314 marked key]] is required to enter it.
  • File:TheCultPart2DormsMap.png|Room location marked on map File:Marked Room Door.png|Door to the room File:Customs Cultist priest's note spawn.png|Note on a stack of books
    • ====Streets of Tarkov==== Marked room on the third floor of the northern abandoned factory building. A [[Abandoned factory marked key]] is required to enter it.
  • File:AbandonedFactoryNorthernBuilding.png|Room location marked on map File:FactoryMarkedRoomDoor.png|Door to the room File:Streets of Tarkov Cultist priest's note spawn.png|Note on the floor
    • ====Reserve==== =====RB-BK===== Marked room on the first floor of the black pawn barrack building. A [[RB-BK marked key]] is required to enter it.
  • File:RB-BK lock location.png|Room location marked on map File:2019-10-28marked.png|Door to the room File:Reserve RB-BK Cultist priest's note spawn.png|Note on the bookshelf
    • =====RB-PKPM===== Marked room next to the command office in the underground tunnel system. A [[RB-PKPM marked key]] is required to enter it.
  • File:RB-PKPM.png|Room location marked on underground map File:RBPKPM Entrance.png|Door to the room File:Reserve RB-PKPM Cultist priest's note spawn.png|Note on the fallen over bookshelf
    • =====RB-VO===== Marked room in the security barrack building on [[Reserve]]. A [[RB-VO marked key]] is required to enter it.
  • File:RB-VO lock location.png|Room location marked on map File:RB-VO.png|Door to the room File:Reserve RB-VO Cultist priest's note spawn.png|Note on the bookshelf
    • ===Locate the place marked with the Eye of the World on Lighthouse/Investigate the cultist room in the chalet/Obtain the victim's key=== {|class="wikitable" ! colspan="5" |Related Quest Items |- !Icon !Item name !Amount !Requirement !'''[[Found in raid|Find in raid]]''' |- ![[File:Victim's note icon.png|link=Victim's note]] |[[Victim's note]] |1 |Required !Yes |- ![[File:Station 14-4 KORD Arshavin K. pass (Damaged) icon.png|link=Station 14-4 KORD Arshavin K. pass (Damaged)]] |[[Station 14-4 KORD Arshavin K. pass (Damaged)]] |1 |Required !Yes |} The wanted place is the small southern bedroom on the second floor of the northern blue chalet on [[Lighthouse]]. The [[Victim's note]] to pick up and read can be found on the adjacent balcony. The [[Station 14-4 KORD Arshavin K. pass (Damaged)]] is located on an ATV in front of the garage opposite the chalet.
  • File:BlueChaletMapKTT.png|Chalet marked on map File:Victim's Note Spawn.png|Note on the balcony File:14-4 dmg. Spawn.png|Keycard on the ATV
    • ===Locate the place marked with the Eye of the World on Woods=== {|class="wikitable" ! colspan="5" |Related Quest Items |- !Icon !Item name !Amount !Requirement !'''[[Found in raid|Find in raid]]''' |- ![[File:Newspaper clipping from the cultists' house icon.png|link=Newspaper clipping from the cultists' house]] |[[Newspaper clipping from the cultists' house]] |1 |Required !Yes |} The wanted place is a house in the dilapidated village in the north of [[Woods]]. The [[Newspaper clipping from the cultists' house]] to pick up and read can be found on a whiteboard next to the desk.
  • File:EFT TAAH Woods House Map.png|House location marked on map File:EFT TAAH Woods House.png|The wanted house File:EFT TAAH Woods Newspaper.png|Newspaper on the whiteboard
    • ===Locate the place marked with the Eye of the World on Shoreline/Investigate the area/Repair the Sordi tower=== {|class="wikitable" ! colspan="6" |Related Quest Items |- !Icon !Item name !Amount !Requirement !'''[[Found in raid|Find in raid]]''' !Notes |- |[[File:Toolsicon.png|link=Toolset]] |[[Toolset]] |1 |Required !N/A |This item is used to repair the Sordi tower. When used, the item is removed from the players' inventory. |- ![[File:Programmer's note icon.png|link=Programmer's note]] |[[Programmer's note]] |1 |Required !Yes | |} The wanted place is a red metal shack at the radio tower near the "Road to Customs" extraction on [[Shoreline]]. The [[Programmer's note]] to pick up and read can be found on a dead body next to the tower. To repair the tower, a [[Toolset]] has to be used inside the shack.
  • File:Shoreline Eye of World Map.jpg|Radio tower location marked on map File:Signal3.png|The radio tower File:Shoreline Eye of World Location.png|The shack File:Shoreline Eye of World Dead Body Relative Location.png|Location of the body File:Note in dead body.png|The note at the right hand of the body File:Repair location for the Sordi tower.png|Repair location in the shack
    • ===Learn more about Station 14-4 KORD from [[Mechanic]]=== Visit [[Mechanic]] in the menu through the trader screen and ask him about the Eye of the World again. ===Restore Arshavin's keycard=== {|class="wikitable" ! colspan="6" |Related Quest Items |- !Icon !Item name !Amount !Requirement !'''[[Found in raid|Find in raid]]''' !Notes |- ![[File:Station 14-4 KORD Arshavin K. pass (Restored) icon.png|link=Station 14-4 KORD Arshavin K. pass (Restored)]] |[[Station 14-4 KORD Arshavin K. pass (Restored)]] |1 |Required !N/A |Has to be crafted in the [[Hideout]] (Intelligence center lv. 1). |} Craft the [[Station 14-4 KORD Arshavin K. pass (Restored)]] at the Intelligence Center level 1 in the [[Hideout]]. Electricity is required during the entire process, otherwise it will be interrupted. ===Gain access to NGO Cobalt's secret facility=== {|class="wikitable" ! colspan="6" |Related Quest Items |- !Icon !Item name !Amount !Requirement !'''[[Found in raid|Find in raid]]''' |- ![[File:Station 14-4 KORD Arshavin K. pass (Restored) icon.png|link=Station 14-4 KORD Arshavin K. pass (Restored)]] |[[Station 14-4 KORD Arshavin K. pass (Restored)]] |1 |Required !N/A |} NGO Cobalt's secret facility is located in the basement of the power station on [[Interchange]]. A [[Station 14-4 KORD Arshavin K. pass (Restored)]] is required to enter it.
  • File:PowerStationMap.png|Power station marked on map File:InterchangePowerStation.png|The power station File:PowerStationStairsDoor.png|Door to the basement stairs File:Station 14-4 KORD Door.png|Door to the secret facility
    • ===Restore power at the station=== To restore the power you have to swipe the [[Station 14-4 KORD Arshavin K. pass (Restored)]] at the keycard panel directly next to the entrance door.
  • File:Reader in 14-4 KORD.png|The keycard panel
    • ===Turn on the cooling system in the server room=== The server room is located behind the grate door. To turn on the cooling system, flip the lever in the back.
  • File:Grate door in 14-4 KORD.png|The grate door File:Lever in 14-4 KORD.png|The lever
    • ===Install a flash drive to download the data=== {|class="wikitable" ! colspan="6" |Related Quest Items |- !Icon !Item name !Amount !Requirement !'''[[Found in raid|Find in raid]]''' !Notes |- |[[File:Secure Flash drive Icon.png|link=Secure Flash drive]] |[[Secure Flash drive]] |1 |Required !N/A |Stashed item |} The [[Secure Flash drive]] has to be stashed to the left of the cooling system lever in the server room.
  • File:USB Plant Location inside Cooling Room in 14-4 KORD.png|Stashing location
    • ===Investigate ARRS Station 14-4 KORD thoroughly=== {|class="wikitable" ! colspan="5" |Related Quest Items |- !Icon !Item name !Amount !Requirement !'''[[Found in raid|Find in raid]]''' |- ![[File:Mysterious audio tape icon.png|link=Mysterious audio tape]] |[[Mysterious audio tape]] |1 |Required !Yes |} To fulfill this objective, you have to pick up and listen to the [[Mysterious audio tape]] from the safe next to the entrance door. The safe opens automatically after turning on the cooling system.
  • File:Mysterious Audio Tape spawn.png|The tape in the safe
    • ===Survive and extract from Interchange=== Extract from [[Interchange]] with either the "Survived" or "Run-Through" extraction status. ===Find a way to disconnect the station from external agents=== {|class="wikitable" ! colspan="5" |Related Quest Items |- !Icon !Item name !Amount !Requirement !'''[[Found in raid|Find in raid]]''' |- ![[File:ARRS station mechanic's notes icon.png|link=ARRS station mechanic's notes]] |[[ARRS station mechanic's notes]] |1 |Required !Yes |} Return to the secret facility on [[Interchange]] and pick up and read the [[ARRS station mechanic's notes]] from the big desk.
  • File:ARRS mech..png|The notes on the desk
    • ===Restore the ARRS station to backup settings=== Turn on the power again, then go inside the server room and press the button under the table. '''Note:''' Only 1 player per raid can press the button and get progress on this objective. If you can't interact with it, return in a new raid.
  • File:ARRS disconnect button.png|The button
    • ===Collect the flash drive from the ARRS station=== {| style="border:2px solid #a52019; width:100%; margin:1em auto 1em auto; padding:5px;" | style="text-align:center;" | [[File:Icon-warning-red.svg|100px]]'''Completing the previous objective first is required to obtain the major evidence [[ARRS system specifications]]!''' |} {|class="wikitable" ! colspan="5" |Related Quest Items |- !Icon !Item name !Amount !Requirement !'''[[Found in raid|Find in raid]]''' |- ![[File:Flash drive for ARRS station icon.png|link=Flash drive for ARRS station]] |[[Flash drive for ARRS station]] |1 |Handover item !Yes |} Pick up the [[Flash drive for ARRS station]] from the server next to the cooling system lever.
  • File:ARRS USB spawn.png|The flash drive
    • ===Survive and extract from Interchange=== Extract from [[Interchange]] with either the "Survived" or "Run-Through" extraction status. ===Hand over the flash drive with data to [[Mechanic]]=== Hand the [[Flash drive for ARRS station]] over to [[Mechanic]] through the trader screen. ===Read the ARRS station specifications=== {|class="wikitable" ! colspan="6" |Related Quest Items |- !Icon !Item name !Amount !Requirement !'''[[Found in raid|Find in raid]]''' |- ![[File:ARRS system specifications icon.png|link=ARRS system specifications]] |[[ARRS system specifications]] |1 |Required !N/A |} Read the [[ARRS system specifications]] from the handbook. ====Rewards==== * +128,000 [[EXP]] * Unlocks achievement [[Achievements#Achievements|Through Another's Eyes]] * Unlocks achievement [[Achievements#Achievements|When the Light Fades]] {{Navbox story chapters}} [[Category:Story chapters]] [[ru:Они уже здесь]]

accidental-witness.wikitext:

the-labyrinth.wikitext:
{{Infobox quest |image =The Labyrinth Chapter Banner.png |icon =The Labyrinth Chapter Icon.png |icon size = |location = |given by = |reward = |reputation = |quest number = |previous = |leads to = |related = |related2 = |reqkappa = }} ''For the location, see [[The Labyrinth]].'' '''The Labyrinth''' is a [[Story chapters|story chapter]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''. ==Description== {{quote|Even before the raid on the TerraGroup office, I'd heard about their underground sites in Tarkov. They say that under the coastal Health Resort, a few months back, they found either a bomb shelter or another lab - "The Labyrinth"... I should definitely check that place, maybe I can learn more about what TerraGroup was up to.}} ==Requirements== * Locate the [[The Labyrinth]] transit on [[Shoreline]]. The transit is located in the basement of the health resort west wing and requires the [[Knossos LLC facility key]].
  • File:Vitamins1 Shoreline outdoor map.png|Health resort west wing location marked on map File:The Labyrinth Transit Map.png|Transit location marked on west wing basement map File:The Labyrinth Transit Door.png|Door to the transit File:The Labyrinth Transit.png|The transit
    • ==Objectives== * Ask the traders about the [[The Labyrinth|underground facility]] ** (''Optional'') Ask [[Therapist]] how to access the [[The Labyrinth|underground facility]] * Wait for [[Jaeger]] to gather the [[Labrys access keycard|keycards]] * Figure out what happened to the BEAR squad ** (''Optional'') Locate the entrance to the [[The Labyrinth|underground facility]] beneath the Health Resort ** (''Optional'') Access the [[The Labyrinth|facility]] ** (''Optional'') Locate the [[Leshy's orders|traces]] of the BEAR squad in [[The Labyrinth]] ** (''Optional'') Investigate the BEAR squad regroup spot at Item 1156 ** (''Optional'') Locate the squad leader ** (''Optional'') Gather more [[Leshy's diary|information]] about the squad ** (''Optional'') Investigate the 5 lab staff bodies ** (''Optional'') Access the [[Observation room key|locked office]] * Listen to the [[Deceased scientist's audio tape|audio tape]] from the office * Hand over the [[Deceased scientist's audio tape|audio tape]] to [[Jaeger]] * Read the [[Labyrinth facility research report]] ** (''Optional'') Locate and obtain the [[Labyrinth facility research report]] ==Guide== ===Speak to [[Jaeger]]=== Visit [[Jaeger]] in the menu through the trader screen and ask him about the underground facility. ===Wait for [[Jaeger]] to gather the keycards=== Wait 12-24 hours then visit [[Jaeger]] in the menu through the trader screen and ask him about the Labyrinth. After finishing the dialogue, [[Jaeger]] provides 2 [[Labrys access keycard]]s via in-game mail and has a barter for more available. ===Access the underground facility=== [[The Labyrinth]] can only be entered with a [[Labrys access keycard]] through [[Transits|transiting]] from [[Shoreline]]. The transit is located in the basement of the health resort west wing and requires the [[Knossos LLC facility key]]. '''Note:''' This location has some [[The_Labyrinth#Features| unique features]] that you should read up on before your first visit.
  • File:Vitamins1 Shoreline outdoor map.png|Health resort west wing location marked on map File:The Labyrinth Transit Map.png|Transit location marked on west wing basement map File:The Labyrinth Transit Door.png|Door to the transit File:The Labyrinth Transit.png|The transit
    • ===Locate the traces of the BEAR squad=== {|class="wikitable" ! colspan="5" |Related Quest Items |- !Icon !Item name !Amount !Requirement !'''[[Found in raid|Find in raid]]''' |- ![[File:Leshy's orders icon.png|link=Leshy's orders]] |[[Leshy's orders]] |1 |Required !Yes |} [[Leshy's orders]] need to be found to fulfill this objective. They can be found in a food container on the ground in front of spawn chamber 2.
  • File:Leshy's orders location map.png|Location marked on map File:Leshy's orders location far.png|Orders location in the food container File:Leshy's orders location close.png|The orders
    • ===Investigate the BEAR squad regroup spot at Item 1156=== The regroup spot is located at the prototype weapon area.
  • File:Labryrinth missile area map.png|Prototype weapon area marked on map
    • ===Locate the squad leader/Gather more information about the squad=== {|class="wikitable" ! colspan="5" |Related Quest Items |- !Icon !Item name !Amount !Requirement !'''[[Found in raid|Find in raid]]''' |- ![[File:Leshy's diary icon.png|link=Leshy's diary]] |[[Leshy's diary]] |1 |Required !Yes |} The squad leader is located at the torture room. [[Leshy's diary]] can be found next to him.
  • File:Labryrinth torture room map.png|Torture room location marked on map File:Leshy's diary location far.png|Squad leader location next to the torture room File:Leshy's diary location close.png|The diary
    • ===Investigate the 5 lab staff bodies=== {|class="wikitable" ! colspan="5" |Related Quest Items |- !Icon !Item name !Amount !Requirement !'''[[Found in raid|Find in raid]]''' |- ![[File:Observation room key icon.png|link=Observation room key]] |[[Observation room key]] |1 |Required !N/A |- ![[File:Assistant's notes on Group 3 icon.png|link=Assistant's notes on Group 3]] |[[Assistant's notes on Group 3|Assistant's notes on Group #3]] |1 |Required !Yes |- ![[File:Assistant's notes on Group 8 icon.png|link=Assistant's notes on Group 8]] |[[Assistant's notes on Group 8|Assistant's notes on Group #8]] |1 |Required !Yes |- ![[File:Assistant's notes on Group 3 and Group 10 icon.png|link=Assistant's notes on Group 3 and Group 10]] |[[Assistant's notes on Group 3 and Group 10|Assistant's notes on Group #3 and Group #10]] |1 |Required !Yes |- ![[File:Assistant's notes on Group 12 icon.png|link=Assistant's notes on Group 12]] |[[Assistant's notes on Group 12|Assistant's notes on Group #12]] |1 |Required !Yes |- ![[File:Assistant's notes on TG-Vi-24 test subjects icon.png|link=Assistant's notes on TG-Vi-24 test subjects]] |[[Assistant's notes on TG-Vi-24 test subjects]] |1 |Required !Yes |} For this objective you have to pick up 5 notes located next to lab scientist bodies. #4 requires the [[Observation room key]].
  • File:The Labyrinth Scientist locations map.png|Scientist locations marked on map File:Assistant note 3 spawn.png|#1: Assistant's notes on Group #3 under the right hand File:Assistant note 3 and 10 spawn.png|#2: Assistant's notes on Group #8 under the left arm File:Assistant note 8 spawn.png|#3: Assistant's notes on Group #3 and Group #10 next to the body File:Assistant note 12 spawn.png|#4: Assistant's notes on Group #12 under the body File:Assistant note on TG-Vi-24 test subject spawn.png|#5: Assistant's notes on TG-Vi-24 test subjects under the head

    • ===Listen to the audio tape from the office=== {|class="wikitable" ! colspan="5" |Related Quest Items |- !Icon !Item name !Amount !Requirement !'''[[Found in raid|Find in raid]]''' |- ![[File:Deceased scientist's audio tape icon.png|link=Deceased scientist's audio tape]] |[[Deceased scientist's audio tape]] |1 |Handover item !Yes |} The audio tape is located on the ground under the right hand of the scientist.
  • File:Deceased scientist's audio tape location far.png|The scientist File:Deceased scientist's audio tape location close.png|The audio tape
    • ===Hand over the audio tape to [[Jaeger]]=== Hand the [[Deceased scientist's audio tape]] over to [[Jaeger]] through the trader screen. ====Rewards==== * 500,000 Roubles * 1× [[Accuracy International AXMC .338 LM bolt-action sniper rifle]] * 2× [[AI AXMC .338 LM 10-round magazine]] * 2× [[.338 Lapua Magnum FMJ ammo pack (20 pcs)]] ===Obtain and read the Labyrinth facility research report=== {|class="wikitable" ! colspan="5" |Related Quest Items |- !Icon !Item name !Amount !Requirement !'''[[Found in raid|Find in raid]]''' |- ![[File:Labyrinth facility research report icon.png|link=Labyrinth facility research report]] |[[Labyrinth facility research report]] |1 |Required !Yes |} The report is located at the drain pipe next to the pier on [[Shoreline]].
  • File:Labyrinth facility research report location map.png|Location marked on map File:Labyrinth facility research report location far.png|Report location at the pipe File:Labyrinth facility research report location close.png|The report
    • ====Rewards==== * +160,000 [[EXP]] * Unlocks achievement [[Achievements#Achievements|Theseus]] {{Navbox story chapters}} [[Category:Story chapters]] [[ru:Лабиринт (глава истории)]]

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a [[Quests|Quest]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Dialogue==
{{quote|Greetings, warrior. Get over here, I've got a job for you. As you know, I deal in gear and supplies, and I've got my boys searching every corner of Tarkov for useful loot. Problem is, order are piling up, and sending them out without protection is asking for trouble. That's where you come in. Keep my boys safe along their route. Make those former PMC mercs think twice before taking a shot at them. I'll show you the route on the map. Got it? Good. Here's the catch: you've got to do it all in only a couple runs maximum. My boys won't sit around waiting if something happens to you. Don't let me down, soldier.}}

==Objectives==
* Eliminate 2 PMC operatives on daytime [[Factory]]
* Eliminate 2 PMC operatives on [[Customs]]
* Eliminate 2 PMC operatives on [[Shoreline]]
* Eliminate 2 PMC operatives on [[Reserve]]
* Eliminate 2 PMC operatives on [[Woods]]
* Eliminate 2 PMC operatives on [[Interchange]]
* Eliminate 2 PMC operatives in [[The Lab]]
* Eliminate 2 PMC operatives on [[Ground Zero]]

==Rewards==
* +65,000 EXP
* [[Prapor]] Rep <font color="green">'''+1.5'''</font>
* 400,000 Roubles
** 420,000 Roubles with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 1
** 460,000 Roubles with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 2
* +4 [[Grenade Launchers|Grenade Launchers skill]] levels
* +4 [[Underbarrel Launchers|Underbarrel Launchers skill]] levels
* +4 [[Mag Drills|Mag Drills skill]] levels
* 1× [[SR-2M Veresk 9x21 submachine gun]] (variant FSB)
* 1× [[Rys-T assault helmet (Black)]]
* 1× [[Rys-T face shield]]
* Unlocks barter for [[SR-2M Veresk 9x21 submachine gun]] (variant FSB) at [[Prapor]] LL4
* Unlocks craft for [[Rys-T assault helmet (Black)]] at [[Hideout#modules|Lavatory level 3]]
{{Quote|Ah, here is our hero! Well done, my dogs have already reported that everything went well. Thank you, really helped me out.}}

==Failure Dialogue==
{{quote|So you failed, warrior? I've been told that my guys had to get back on their own, they lost a lot of people and couldn't even find much loot either. Alright, I'll forgive you this time. The next group is packing up soon, so if you want to make amends, then go with them.}}

==Guide==
In this quest you have to kill 2 PMCs each on the specified locations in one run. Dying, disconnecting or going MIA is allowed once before the quest fails and resets.

{{Infobox quest |icon = |image =Banner lighthouse.png |location =[[The Lab]] |given by =[[Mechanic]] |reward = |reputation = |time limit = |quest number = |previous =[[To the Light - Trust but Verify#Requirements|See requirements]] |leads to =[[To the Light - False Call]] (+10-30min) |related = |related2 = |reqkappa =No }} '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a [[Quests|Quest]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''. ==Dialogue== {{quote|I received a request from the lighthouse. The request itself is rather unusual, though. I still don't understand exactly what he's planning, but I remembered your interest and decided to involve you in carrying out the task. You wanted to get in touch with Lightkeeper, didn't you? He gave me a hard drive containing data that needed some... modifications. The drive now needs to be left at the Lab, in one of the server rooms in the testing area. But there are a couple of important conditions. First: the drive needs to be disguised so that whoever finds it believes it's been sitting in the Lab since the evacuation. Setting up a decoy like that will take longer than usual. And if the deception is discovered, we can't expect any future cooperation from Lightkeeper. Second: activating the Lab's internal systems would arouse suspicion from the group that's supposed to take Lightkeeper's bait. So you'll need a quiet way out, such as a ventilation shaft.}} ==Requirements== * Unlock direct access to [[Lighthouse]] by progressing through the story chapter [[Tour]] * Ask [[Mechanic]] about the possibility of working with [[Lightkeeper]] * Reach Loyalty Level 3 with [[Therapist]], [[Skier]], [[Peacekeeper]], [[Mechanic]], [[Ragman]] and [[Jaeger]] ==Objectives== * Stash the [[Hard drive with false data]] in the server room near the weapon testing area in [[The Lab]] (In one raid) ** ''(Optional)'' After that, extract through the Ventilation Shaft * Extract from [[The Lab]] through the Ventilation Shaft (In one raid) ==Rewards== * +35,000 [[EXP]] * 300,000 Roubles ** 315,000 Roubles with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 1 ** 345,000 Roubles with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 2 * 2× [[TerraGroup Labs access keycard]] {{quote|Did you disguise the drive well enough? You're sure? Good. Then I'll inform Lightkeeper that everything is done. While you were gone, I had some time to think about this... I could understand if Lightkeeper wanted to plant disinformation on one of his enemies. But if I'm not mistaken, he's going to send his own people after the hard drive. So what was the point of all our work altering the data and disguising the drive? And why involve outsiders like us instead of using his own resources?}} ==Initial Equipment== {|class="wikitable" !Icon !Item name !Amount !Notes |- |[[File:Hard drive with false data icon.png|link=Hard drive with false data]] |[[Hard drive with false data]] |1 |Stashed item |} ==Guide== {|class="wikitable" ! colspan="6" |Related Quest Items |- !Icon !Item name !Amount !Requirement !'''[[Found in raid|Find in raid]]''' !Notes |- |[[File:Hard drive with false data icon.png|link=Hard drive with false data]] |[[Hard drive with false data]] |1 |Required !N/A |Stashed item |} In this quest you first have to stash the [[Hard drive with false data|hard drive]] provided in your off-raid quest inventory at the servers within the main working area (O11) on the first level of [[The Lab]]. It is not lost upon death. Afterwards you have to extract through the "Ventilation Shaft" extraction in the same raid. It can only be used without a [[backpack]] equipped.

[[To the Light - Someone Called?]] |related = |related2 = |reqkappa =No }} '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a [[Quests|Quest]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''. ==Dialogue== {{quote|Lightkeeper contacted me again. And for this task, he specifically requested the same person who handled the previous job. Meaning you. Our little trick worked, but that doesn't make the whole situation any clearer. I can only assume that, for some reason, Lightkeeper wants to keep all these jobs secret even from his own people. Could he be looking for a mole among them? Either way, this is our only chance to establish a working relationship, so all we can do is carry out the tasks and avoid asking unnecessary questions. Now, the instructions. Lightkeeper wants you to go to the intersection in the Customs area, discreetly install a camera in the little shop, and then send an RSP signal at the road crossing toward the coast. And yes, the entire area around it needs to be cleared of any potential observers beforehand. Once you've sent the signal, get out of there. Whoever comes to the rendezvous point mustn't see you.}} ==Requirements== * Unlocks 10-30 minutes after completion of [[To the Light - Trust but Verify]] ==Objectives== * Eliminate 5 [[Scavs]] during 21:00-06:00 on [[Customs]] (In one raid) * Eliminate 1 PMC operative during 21:00-06:00 on [[Customs]] (In one raid) * Hide a [[WI-FI Camera|Wi-Fi camera]] at the AC unit at the convenience store near the bridge on [[Customs]] (In one raid) * Launch a yellow signal flare at the Shoreline transit on [[Customs]] (In one raid) ==Rewards== * +30,000 [[EXP]] {{quote|So, did you notice anything suspicious? No? Alright. Let's sum up what we know. First, we planted a hard drive containing disinformation at the Lab. Then Lightkeeper sent his group after the drive, and now he's used you to call someone out for a meeting. Obviously, he wants to find out who's going to show up at the rendezvous point. And if he doesn't know that yet, then according to the original plan, someone else was supposed to show up for the meeting. Which means the information about how to arrange the meeting belonged to that person, and Lightkeeper stole it from them. Could it have been our potential mole, the one he identified with the help of that disinformation drive? I think the pieces are starting to fall into place.}} ==Guide== {|class="wikitable" ! colspan="6" |Related Quest Items |- !Icon !Item name !Amount !Requirement !'''[[Found in raid|Find in raid]]''' !Notes |- ![[File:WIFI Camera Icon.png|link=WI-FI Camera]] |[[WI-FI Camera]] |1 |Required !N/A |Can be purchased from [[Mechanic]] LL1. |- ! colspan="6" | Flare - You only need one of the below options |- ![[File:Yellow flare icon.png|link=RSP-30 reactive signal cartridge (Yellow)]] |[[RSP-30 reactive signal cartridge (Yellow)]] |1 |Required !N/A |Must be fired into the sky while being in the transit area. |- ! colspan="6" |OR |- ![[File:SP-81 Icon.png|link=ZiD SP-81 26x75 signal pistol]] |[[ZiD SP-81 26x75 signal pistol]] |1 |Required !N/A |Used to fire the flare cartridge. |- ![[File:26x75 flare cartridge (Yellow) icon.png|link=26x75mm flare cartridge (Yellow)]] |[[26x75mm flare cartridge (Yellow)]] |1 |Required !N/A |Must be fired into the sky while being in the transit area. |} In this quest you have to do the following in one raid on [[Customs]]: Kill 1 PMC and 5 [[Scavs]] in the time period of 21:00-06:00, stash a [[WI-FI Camera]] at the kiosk near the main bridge and launch a yellow flare at the [[Shoreline]] transit. ====WI-FI Camera stashing====
  • File:ThirstyDeliveryCustomsMap.png|Store location marked on map File:ThirstyDeliveryCustomsStore.png|The store File:False Call Camera Location.png|Stashing location at the air conditioning unit
    • ====Shoreline transit==== The transit is located behind the "Sniper Roadblock" Scav extraction. Shoot a yellow flare into the sky while being near the bus. If the flare doesn't reach a certain height, the quest objective won't complete. You can use either the [[RSP-30 reactive signal cartridge (Yellow)|handheld RSP-30 yellow flare]] which can be bought at [[Prapor]] LL1 or a [[26x75mm flare cartridge (Yellow)|26x75mm yellow flare cartridge]] which can be bought at [[Jaeger]] LL1, and is fired from a [[ZiD SP-81 26x75 signal pistol|signal pistol]]. If you use the [[RSP-30 reactive signal cartridge (Yellow)|handheld RSP-30 yellow flare]], make sure to aim it upwards, but not too much or it lands behind you.

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a [[Quests|Quest]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Dialogue==
{{quote|Lightkeeper contacted me again. And for this task, he specifically requested the same person who handled the previous job. Meaning you. Our little trick worked, but that doesn't make the whole situation any clearer.I can only assume that, for some reason, Lightkeeper wants to keep all these jobs secret even from his own people. Could he be looking for a mole among them? Either way, this is our only chance to establish a working relationship, so all we can do is carry out the tasks and avoid asking unnecessary questions. Now, the instructions. Lightkeeper wants you to go to the intersection in the Customs area, discreetly install a camera in the little shop, and then send an RSP signal at the road crossing toward the coast. ==Rewards==

** 315,000 Roubles with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 1
** 345,000 Roubles with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 2

* 3× [[Glock 9x19 17-round magazine]]
* 2× [[9x19mm AP 6.3 ammo pack (50 pcs)]]
* 3× [[RSP-30 reactive signal cartridge (Red)]]
{{quote|So, did you notice anything suspicious? No? Alright. Let's sum up what we know. First, we planted a hard drive containing disinformation at the Lab. Then Lightkeeper sent his group after the drive, and now he's used you to call someone out for a meeting. Obviously, he wants to find out who's going to show up at the rendezvous point. And if he doesn't know that yet, then according to the original plan, someone else was supposed to show up for the meeting. Which means the information about how to arrange the meeting belonged to that person, and Lightkeeper stole it from them. Could it have been our potential mole, the one he identified with the help of that disinformation drive? I think the pieces are starting to fall into place.}}

Returning to the game menu completes the objective.

{{Infobox quest |icon = |image =Dish Served Cold Banner.png |location =[[Woods]], [[Customs]], [[Shoreline]] |given by =[[Mechanic]] |reward = |reputation = |time limit = |quest number = |previous =[[To the Light - False Call]] (+10-15min) |leads to =[[To the Light - Fallen Bird]] |related = |related2 = |reqkappa =No }} '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a [[Quests|Quest]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]'' ==Dialogue== {{Quote|It's nice when you hypotheses are confirmed in practice! Half an hour after you sent the signal, UNTAR soldiers showed up at the rendezvous point. They quickly realized the call was a fake, but Lightkeeper had already learned everything he wanted to know. With this new task, everything falls into place. Something among Lightkeeper's people or his allies has been secretly working with Peacekeeper, and not Lightkeeper is ready to act. We need to plant several signal jammers. The only catch is the Lightkeeper wants everything done quickly, in a single run. Otherwise the effect will be too weak, and we wont get any more jobs from the lighthouse. Start at the weather station in the cliffs at the nature reserve. Install the second jammer in the guard shack at the sawmill. From there, head toward Customs and leave the jammer on the second floor of the construction site by the road, then make your way to the coast. The last jammer goes in the archives of the health resort's administrative building. As soon as you're done, come back to me. We can't keep Lightkeeper waiting.}} ==Requirements== * Unlocks 10-15 minutes after completion of [[To the Light - Trust but Verify]] ==Objectives== * Plant a [[Signal Jammer|Signal jammer]] at the weather station on the mountain on [[Woods]] (In one raid) * Plant a [[Signal Jammer|Signal jammer]] at the sawmill guardhouse on [[Woods]] (In one raid) * Use the transit from [[Woods]] to [[Customs]] (In one raid) * Plant a [[Signal Jammer|Signal jammer]] on the second floor of the roadside construction site on [[Customs]] (In one raid) * Use the transit from [[Customs]] to [[Shoreline]] (In one raid) * Plant a [[Signal Jammer|Signal jammer]] at the second floor archives in the Health Resort admin building on [[Shoreline]] (In one raid) ==Rewards== * +45,000 [[Experience|EXP]] {{Quote|Truth be told, I can't even imagine how Lightkeeper got such detailed information about Peacekeeper's operations. But what you just did is enough to disrupt several major deals the UN officer had in the works. It'll take him a while to recover from a hit like that. As soon as I detected your jamming zones, I contacted Lightkeeper. Now I'm waiting for some kind of package from him. So don't disappear on me, alright?}} ==Guide== {|class="wikitable" ! colspan="6" |Related Quest Items |- !Icon !Item name !Amount !Requirement !'''[[Found in raid|Find in raid]]''' !Notes |- ![[File:Signal Jammer icon.png|link=Signal Jammer]] |[[Signal Jammer]] |4 |Required !N/A |Can be purchased from [[Mechanic]] LL1. |} In this quest you have to stash a [[Signal Jammer]] at the weather station on the mountain on [[Woods]] then place another one at the sawmill guardhouse, after placing them you need to transit from [[Woods]] to [[Customs]], place a signal jammer on the second floor of the roadside construction site then transit from [[Customs]] to [[Shoreline]] and place a signal jammer at the second floor archives in the Health Resort admin building all in one raid. Extracting at any time before the last objective will require you to re-do everything from the beginning. ===[[Woods]]===

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a [[Quests|Quest]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''

==Dialogue==
{{Quote|Mercenary! You need to put all your other jobs on hold and conduct an investigation immediately! I wouldn't come to you if this weren't absolutely critical. Someone has gained access to internal documentation related to UN operations in Tarkov. As a result, several vital support shipments have been disrupted. This isn't just a blow to my business, it's an attempt to destroy it completely! I won't simply let this go. Right now, I can only trust reliable professionals. You must help me find the person who stole this data and punish them. Whoever did this managed to access classified data, which means it must be someone on the inside, or someone with exceptional skills in hacking and decryption. I can give you more leads later, but you can start looking right now. Don't waste any time!}}

{{Quote|What the hell is this?! Who gave you this? I don't believe he allowed you anywhere near him... Kurwa... We'll discuss your involvement in this matter later. For now, leave, and you'd better forget about this job entirely.}}
