'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a [[Quests|Quest]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''

==Dialogue==
{{Quote|I doubt Peacekeeper will ever dare go against Lightkeeper again after everything that's happened. But this isn't over yet. The operatives who kept information from Lightkeeper and secretly worked with Peacekeeper are still alive. And from what I understand, they don't even realize they've been compromised. For some reason, Lightkeeper doesn't want to hold a "public execution" to make an example of them and intimidate the rest of his operatives. Maybe he doesn't see the need, or maybe he's trying to avoid creating another conflict ... Hard to say. But he's going to quietly eliminate the traitors he's already identified. He'll send them on a job where the fighters will supposedly die in the line of duty. The group will arrive at the Lab soon with a new assignment. You need to meet them there and deliver Lightkeeper's sentence to each of them. I'm not sure your skills and the element of surprise will be enough to take down an entire squad of fighters. So you'd better prepare seriously. And don't forget to bring their dogtags. I'll pass them on to Lightkeeper.}}

{{Quote|Excellent. I'll send the dogtags to Lightkeeper with the next shipment. I doubt this whole affair is doing much good for his plans, but it's a unique opportunity for us. And I'm already seeing the positive effects of the work we've done.}}

Lightkeeper has said he's willing to consider meeting you in person. But keep in mind, you're still just one of dozens of operatives to him. The work you've done won't give you any special privileges at the lighthouse. Now Lightkeeper wants you to carry out the job the group of traitors was originally assigned. I don't know if I'd take such a shady job in your place, but that's up to you. You need to deliver classified TerraGroup data to those lunatics who gather at the marked rooms at night. And Lightkeeper wants you to personally deliver each folder to the ritual sites... I can't tell you where to find the folders or how to get into the marked rooms. '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a [[Quests|Quest]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Dialogue==
{{quote|Come on in, brother! I've got a new little business venture here, and I'm looking for someone who can help me out. I was recently contacted by someone from across the border. Turns out there's a demand over there for stuff taken out of Tarkov. I don't really get who'd be into that, but money's money. Especially when it comes to luxury goods with a bit of history from the city. Yeah, that's exactly how the guy put it. I've got the manpower and plenty of motivation to make some serious cash. But most importantly, I've got experience faking luxury goods. I'm thinking of setting up a workshop to put together some Louise Pitton accessories. Go collect some useful stuff around Tarkov from this list, and I'll make it worth your while.}}

* Find 10 [[Golden neck chain]]s [[Found in raid|<font color="red">in raid</font>]]
* Hand over the [[Golden neck chain|items]]

* Hand over the [[Golden rooster figurine|items]]
* Find 5 [[Golden 1GPhone smartphone]]s [[Found in raid|<font color="red">in raid</font>]]
* Hand over the [[Golden 1GPhone smartphone|items]]
* Find 10 [[Simple wallet]]s [[Found in raid|<font color="red">in raid</font>]]
* Hand over the [[Simple wallet|items]]
* Find 5 [[WZ Wallet]]s [[Found in raid|<font color="red">in raid</font>]]
* Hand over the [[WZ Wallet|items]]

==Rewards==
* +30,000 [[EXP]]
* 300,000 Roubles
** 315,000 Roubles with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 1
** 345,000 Roubles with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 2
* 1× [[Loui Peeton deluxe wallet]]
{{quote|You helped me out big time, bro! There's already a queue back home for my goods with a "history". Here, take this, for your help.}}

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a [[Quests|Quest]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Dialogue==
{{quote|Sup, brother! Heard you've started taking boat rides somewhere with the smugglers. You planning to get out of Tarkov by water or something? Hope you know about the naval blockade... And I hope you're not counting on the smugglers' boats being in perfect condition. If you really need to travel by water on their boats, you won't get far without the right tools. I'm telling you that straight, unlike those guys. But you're in luck, ahper! My guys recently cracked open one of the railcars headed either to the port or the Norvinsky pier, and what do you know, it was packed with special repair kits for watercraft! All kinds of patches, sealants, and other stuff. I think you know where I'm going with this, huh? Let's help each other out, and we'll both come out ahead. I could really use some of the tools that aren't included in those kits.}}

==Requirements==
* Tell [[Mechanic]] that you found transport to the [[icebreaker]] in the [[Boreas]] story chapter.

* Hand over the [[Ratchet wrench|item]]
* Find the item [[Found in raid|<font color="red">in raid</font>]]: [[Electric drill]]
* Hand over the [[Electric drill|item]]

==Rewards==
* +30,000 [[EXP]]
* 5× [[Sudak-Tudak marine repair kit]] (10× in the [[Game_modes#PvE_and_PvE_Co-op_game_mode|PvE mode]])
* +1 daily operational task with [[Sudak-Tudak marine repair kit]] reward
{{quote|Now that's the kind of deal I like. As long as people have something to trade, guys like you and me will always come out on top! Here are your kits. And if you need more, you know who to come to.}}

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a [[Quests|Quest]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Dialogue==
{{quote|Good to see you, brother! I've got a job, and it's one only a master like you can handle. Some Scavs recently intercepted a shipment of plate carriers I had near the lighthouse. Nothing too fancy in there, but those fuckers need to pay for stealing my goods! Only, we're gonna do this one a little differently. I want to see how plate carriers in this price range hold up against different calibers, and now we've got a bunch of idiots walking around wearing them! So we might as well make this test as close to real combat as possible. Take two different caliber rifles on the job and do your part. Just don't shoot 'em in the head, okay? I'm interested in how well the armor holds up! Don't bring the carriers back to me. Once you're done, I'll send my guys to collect the "samples".}}

==Requirements==
* Must reach Loyalty Level 3 with [[Ragman]] to obtain this quest.

==Objectives==
* Eliminate any 3 targets with Thorax or Stomach shots using [[7.62x39mm|7.62x39]] caliber weapons on [[Lighthouse]] (In one raid)
* Eliminate any 3 targets with Thorax or Stomach shots using [[7.62x51mm NATO|7.62x51]] caliber weapons on [[Lighthouse]] (In one raid)

==Rewards==
* +28,000 [[EXP]]
* [[Ragman]] Rep <font color="green">'''+0.75'''</font>
* 275,000 Roubles
** 288,750 Roubles with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 1
** 316,250 Roubles with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 2
* 1× [[Gruppa 99 T30 backpack (MultiCam)]]
* 1× [[HighCom Trooper TFO body armor (MultiCam)]]
* 2× [[Power cord]]
{{quote|So, you tired from lugging two guns around? But most importantly, you did the job right, as always! I'll send my guys after the armor now. You get some rest. Maybe these tests will even give us some ideas for improving the gear...}}

I've got one deal that's still hanging over my head, and I could really use some help. But I'll tell you right now, you can throw your back out in no time doing this! So, I've made contact with the smugglers. Wouldn't exactly call it a partnership, but they've got a decent job for me. We need to deliver some armor plates to their boys. Everything's already packed up and waiting at the drop-off points, so all that's left is getting it to the recipients. You in? Both cases with the armor plates are in Priozersk right now. One's in the bunker, and the other's at the abandoned USEC checkpoint. One case needs to be hauled to the guardhouse at the military base. You want the one next to the trail leading to Woods. The second case is supposed to go in the railcar with the Ural truck at the train station near the water treatment plant. Once you've left both cases at the right spots, let the armored train engineer know.}} ==Requirements== * Must reach Loyalty Level 3 with [[Ragman]] to obtain this quest. ==Objectives== * Locate and obtain the [[Case with goods for the smugglers 1|first smuggler case]] in the ZB-014 bunker on [[Woods]] * Stash the [[Case with goods for the smugglers 1|first case]] in the guard booth near the [[Woods]] transit on [[Reserve]] * Locate and obtain the [[Case with goods for the smugglers 2|second smuggler case]] behind the shack at the USEC checkpoint on [[Woods]] * Stash the [[Case with goods for the smugglers 2|second case]] in the railcar with the Ural truck at the train platform on [[Lighthouse]] * Extract from [[Lighthouse]] or [[Reserve]] through the Armored Train '''Note:''' The "Extract" objective will appear after the "Stash" objectives are completed. ==Rewards== * +28,000 [[EXP]] * [[Ragman]] Rep '''+0.75''' * 275,000 Roubles ** 288,750 Roubles with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 1 ** 316,250 Roubles with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 2 * 1× [[Ballistic plate case]] * 2× [[Power cord]] {{quote|After a job like that, you oughta spend at least a couple days lying down, brother! '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a [[Quests|Quest]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Dialogue==
{{quote|The Scavs at Lighthouse are getting a little too damn bold. They won't let me work in peace. They try to ambush my passengers at the stops, and they're even looting the stops themselves! Naturally, they do it when the BTR isn't around, so there's nobody there to teach them a lesson. Maybe you could help me out? We need to scare them off, or better yet, make it clear that the BTR is here on this stretch of coast for the long haul. I can't be here all the time myself. I've got business in Priozersk and in the city, but you could make it look like I'm still around! Just use the same caliber my coax gun does. Once you scare the shit out of them, they'll probably get used to how things work around here now.}}

==Objectives==
* Eliminate 15 [[Scavs]] with any [[7.62x54mmR|7.62x54R]] caliber weapon on [[Lighthouse]]
* Report back to the [[BTR Driver]]

==Rewards==
* +30,000 [[EXP]]
* 2× [[VPX Flash Storage Module]]
* 2× [[Virtex programmable processor]]
* 2× [[Military flash drive]]
{{quote|Well shit, you saved my ass, dude! My passengers are already asking where I got a second BTR from, since I'm somehow in two places at once... Here, take this. I found it recently at my old depot base. Pulled it out of the basement there.}}

==Guide==
In this quest you have to kill 15 [[Scavs]] on [[Lighthouse]] using a [[7.62x54mmR]] weapon.
